question: how many invoices did we issue last month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bills WHERE type='Invoice' AND created_at>='2026-05-01' AND created_at<'2026-06-01'
notes: HOLDOUT (app-derived). Tests 'last month' (dev only had 'this month'). created_at, type='Invoice'.

question: how many invoices have been fully paid?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id) x WHERE ABS(x.amt - x.paid) <= 0.01
notes: HOLDOUT. fully paid = |balance|<=0.01 (PAID only, EXCLUDES overpaid) per Bill::paymentState() single-source-of-truth. Corrected 2026-06-27 w/ sign-off (was amt-paid<=0.01, which lumped in overpaid). Tests the amount-minus-payments PATTERN.

question: what was our revenue last month?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(j.credit-j.debit),0) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_REVENUE','NON_OPERATING_REVENUE') AND j.post_date>='2026-05-01' AND j.post_date<'2026-06-01'
notes: HOLDOUT. Revenue formula + 'last month' (dev had 'this month'/'by month').

question: what's the total value of all invoices this year?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)),0) FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' AND YEAR(b.created_at)=2026
notes: HOLDOUT (admin tier, no redaction). Invoice-value formula as a grand total (new shape vs dev's per-customer/per-month).

question: which customer has the highest total in quotations?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)),0) total FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=b.customer_id WHERE b.type='Quotation' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
notes: HOLDOUT. Quotation value formula + per-customer top-1 (dev had this for invoices, not quotes).

gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(j.debit-j.credit),0) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE a.account_type='OPERATING_EXPENSE' AND j.post_date>='2026-06-01' AND j.post_date<'2026-07-01'
notes: HOLDOUT. EXPENSE side: SUM(debit-credit) on OPERATING_EXPENSE (sign flips vs revenue per Account::balance). Dev never tested expenses — a true generalization probe.

question: how many invoices are more than 60 days overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, b.due_date, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.due_date) x WHERE x.amt - x.paid > 0.01 AND x.due_date < '2026-04-17'
notes: HOLDOUT. Receivable + 60-day overdue (anchor 2026-06-16 minus 60 = 2026-04-17). Dev had 30-day.

question: how many invoices are partially paid?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id) x WHERE x.paid > 0.01 AND x.amt - x.paid > 0.01
notes: HOLDOUT. Partial payment = paid>0 AND balance>0.01.

question: how many invoices have been overpaid?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id) x WHERE x.paid - x.amt > 0.01
notes: HOLDOUT. Overpaid = payments exceed invoice value by >0.01.

question: break unpaid receivables into standard aging buckets
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN x.due_date >= '2026-05-17' THEN '0-30 days' WHEN x.due_date >= '2026-04-17' THEN '31-60 days' WHEN x.due_date >= '2026-03-18' THEN '61-90 days' ELSE '90+ days' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(x.amt-x.paid),0) outstanding FROM (SELECT b.id, b.due_date, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.due_date) x WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 GROUP BY bucket
notes: HOLDOUT. Standard 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ buckets; anchor 2026-06-16 date literals.

question: which customer owes us the most in outstanding receivables?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(x.amt-x.paid),0) AS outstanding FROM (SELECT b.id, b.customer_id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.customer_id) x JOIN customers c ON c.id=x.customer_id WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY outstanding DESC LIMIT 1
notes: HOLDOUT. Per-customer outstanding total.

question: which customer has the most overdue invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT b.id, b.customer_id, b.due_date, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.customer_id, b.due_date) x JOIN customers c ON c.id=x.customer_id WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 AND x.due_date <= '2026-06-16' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
notes: HOLDOUT. Overdue = unpaid AND due_date before anchor today.

question: how many unpaid invoices are more than 45 days overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, b.due_date, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.due_date) x WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 AND x.due_date < '2026-05-02'
notes: HOLDOUT. >45 days overdue: due_date < 2026-05-02 (anchor minus 45).

question: what is the total value of overdue receivables?

question: how many customers have at least one invoice more than 60 days overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.customer_id) FROM (SELECT b.id, b.customer_id, b.due_date, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.customer_id, b.due_date) x WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 AND x.due_date < '2026-04-17'
notes: HOLDOUT. Distinct customers with >60-day overdue unpaid invoice.
